headline:

title: Etsy 4x6 shipping label printing too small? Start with the PDF
description: A 4x6 label inside a Letter-size PDF is different from a 4x6 PDF page. Check the carrier, original file, paper size and loaded stock before changing scaling. Etsy's documented 4x6 format applies to USPS labels. Read the practical checklist. Tagrivo contains Amazon affiliate links.

description: A Bluetooth setup feature is not necessarily Bluetooth label printing. Follow the device, connection and app route before choosing a shipping printer for your small business.
